summary: The MyZubster community demo actor records that the MYZ-188 contract keeps University, Developer and Community roles separate, uses public GitHub evidence, and does not infer payment, employment, partnership or institutional endorsement. Runtime seeding and graph smoke remain a separate deployment gate.

checks.note: University, Developer and Community use distinct actor IDs and actor types.
All three pilot profile repositories are public GitHub repositories.
GitHub issue #1335 is the bounded canonical work item for the pilot.
Contribution state is explicitly separate from bounty, reward and payment state.
The university actor is a MyZubster technical profile/template and does not assert external university endorsement.
Run the seed against an authorized MongoDB environment, then smoke GET /api/ecosystem/graph?projectId=myz-188-university-developer-community.
